verdict.score_rationale: The board fits the 6 anchor because its structured stage grid and restrained semantic tints show deliberate composition, but the large lower dead band, uneven right-side extension, and visible routing ambiguities prevent it from reading as fully finished.

sub_checks.name: frame_use
sub_checks.note: Fail: most content occupies the upper and middle frame while a broad, nearly empty band remains across the bottom, with the tall rebuild panel creating an unbalanced rightward tail.

sub_checks.name: color
sub_checks.note: Pass: pale blue, cyan, green, purple, and orange consistently distinguish stage families, although the gray dashed feedback route lacks an explicit failure-red semantic.

sub_checks.name: machinery_leakage
sub_checks.note: Fail: the publication area contains a bracket-like vertical rail with tick marks, and several shared branch/merge routes around publication and feedback read ambiguously rather than as polished final wiring.

sub_checks.name: alignment_and_rhythm
sub_checks.note: Fail: the two principal stage rows register well, but inconsistent panel heights, sparse interiors, the low isolated rebuild column, and awkward text wrapping such as “Term s” disrupt the overall rhythm.
